  3. Asset readiness check

Five answers show which step of the engine an asset should start from.

Is your idle land, under-let building or under-used facility ready to earn? Answer five questions, one for each step of HAYKALAH’s asset-monetization engine: Audit → Optimize → Structure → Operate → Monetize. The check shows where the work on your asset would start. It asks for no personal details.

Asset readiness check

  1. Step 1 · AuditDo you have a current record of what the asset costs to hold and how it is used?

    An inventory, utilization record and cost baseline for every asset.

    Please answer this question.

  2. Step 2 · OptimizeHas a highest-and-best use been identified for the asset?

    Highest-and-best-use analysis, re-planning and activation.

    Please answer this question.

  3. Step 3 · StructureIs the ownership of the asset clear and documented?

    A concession, JV SPV, Musataha, Ijara or revenue share, and a fund or Sukuk at scale.

    Please answer this question.

  4. Step 4 · OperateIs it clear who would run the asset, and how its performance would be measured?

    Operators appointed under contract, with performance measured from day one.

    Please answer this question.

  5. Step 5 · MonetizeIs recurring income the goal, rather than a one-off sale?

    Recurring income, refinancing and capital recycling.

    Please answer this question.

Please answer all five questions.

The check runs in your browser and needs JavaScript to show a result. You can still read the five questions, or send a request.

Send a request

  • Not advice, not a valuation.
  • Not investment advice.
  • Your answers stay in your browser. Nothing is sent unless you choose to send a request.

How it works

  1. 1Answer five questions. Each has three answers: ready, partly ready or not yet.
  2. 2See where to start. The first step that is not yet ready is where the work would start.
  3. 3Read each step. Every answer comes with a line on what it means for that step.
  4. 4Talk it through, if you wish. The request form opens with Turning expenses into revenue and Monetization filled in.

Questions

Is the result a valuation?

No. The check gives a first indication from your own answers. It is not advice, not a valuation and not investment advice. Whether a specific asset qualifies depends on the audit.

What happens to my answers?

They stay in your browser. Nothing is sent unless you choose to send a request, and your answers are not attached to it.

Which assets is the check for?

Typical candidates are idle land, under-let malls and hotels, staff housing, corporate estates, stadiums and cultural venues.

What happens if I send a request?

A member of the HAYKALAH team replies personally, from an @haykalah.com address. We can start under an NDA.
